registeredWinners.browserObservation: Registered_Winners could lead m049 in selected old-browser cohorts, especially when Code_Jokers was absent. The browser uses older War/scoring/Zombie semantics and is diagnostic only.
registeredWinners.geometryFinding: Registered_Winners uses symmetric phase/step geometry. Copying that geometry could flip a worst browser context but regressed official 2025 gates, so it was rejected.

warrior1.finding: Complex INT 86h writer plus relocation/Phoenix behavior.

warrior2.finding: Small partner that derives a jump target through the shared segment; it does not target m049's initializer signature.

sharedSignatureScreen.protocol: Four Code_Jokers target cohorts plus two preselected sentinel cohorts, two seeds, 100 battles per run, 1200 battles per candidate.
sharedSignatureScreen.decision: All shared-signature variants failed the sentinel non-regression gate.

conclusion: Neither Registered_Winners nor Code_Jokers demonstrated a general official-v6 advantage over m049. Every attempted defense that improved the targeted Code_Jokers contexts caused a material loss on broader sentinel cohorts. No source or binary was promoted to final/.
